notes.title: Winter Wonderland Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow travelers.

We've been actively listening to your feedback over the past few months, and we're excited to announce a significant game update! This update focuses on enhancing your gaming experience by addressing bug fixes, fine-tuning game balance, and resolving various issues that you've highlighted. Our commitment is to provide a smoother, more enjoyable gaming experience, and we're grateful for your continued support and valuable suggestions that help us improve.

🌠 Brace yourselves for a delightful ride through our latest improvements:

🗣️ Voiceover Extravaganza: We've waved the magic wand! Say goodbye to repetitive chatter! Voiceovers now make their grand appearance just once. No more déjà vu!🌟

🎨 UI Transformation: Our UI has gotten a slight makeover! Expect more vibrance, more style, and an extra splash of creativity. Our visual party never stops! 🖌️

🧠 AI Revolution: Our AI has leveled up! Expect a brainier, trickier opponent on each difficulty level. Ready for the challenge? 💡

🎯 Piece Placement Precision: Say hello to pinpoint accuracy in piece placement! We've fine-tuned those hitboxes to ensure every click counts. 📍

🌐 Language Adventure: On a quest to squash typos in every language! Found one? Give us a shout, and we'll jump into action. 📢

🐲 Cixi's Fair Play: We've adjusted Cixi's castling powers. No more sneaky moves when she's down to her last King. It's all about fairness now! ⚖️

🛡️ Lagertha's Loyal Army: Lagertha’s troops were a bit too good at hide-and-seek, staying invisible. We’ve fixed this bug, and now they return as expected! 🎩

🗡️ Leonidas' Warm-up: Remember when Leonidas was freezing during loading? We've relocated him closer to the Realm of Hades for some much-needed warmth. No more chilly battles for him! 🔥

📜 Juana's Clarity: Got puzzled by Juana's powers? We've cleared the air. She might be mad, but we try to make her easier to understand on a winter sunny day. 🌈

🎮 Demo Redesign: Our long-neglected demo has finally been updated to reflect the current state of the game. Dive in and see what's new! 🆕

♟️ Dark Chess Strategy: The turn repetition rule in the fog is back! Say farewell to endless move loops and hello to strategic gameplay. 🌫️

🌠 Your insights are our guiding light, helping us make the game more epic. Thank you for your trust and dedication! Let’s keep the fun rolling! 🚀🎲🎮

notes.title: Apples and Penguins update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Dark Chess players! 
We are thrilled to announce an exciting update that brings a host of new features and improvements to enhance your gaming experience. 
Let's dive right in:

🍎🐧 Mac and Linux Versions:
We heard you, and we're delighted to unveil the highly anticipated Mac and Linux versions of Dark Chess! Now, you can enjoy the game on your preferred operating system.

✨Enhanced Chess Board Lighting:
We have fine-tuned the lighting effects to create an even more immersive and visually stunning gameplay environment. 

💫 Improved Move Indications:
We understand the importance of clear and precise move indications. In this update, we have added more helpful indicators to assist you during gameplay, ensuring that you never miss your turn. 

⏩⏪ Animation Speed Customisation:
Personalize your gaming experience with the new animation speed setting in the options menu. Whether you prefer a leisurely-paced game or lightning-fast animations, you now have the freedom to tailor the animation speed to your liking. 

🇩🇪 German Localisation Progress:
We are thrilled to announce that we have begun the process of localising Dark Chess into German! 
We believe in providing a truly global experience and are committed to making Dark Chess accessible to players around the world 🌍

We greatly appreciate your support and feedback. Your input has been invaluable in shaping Dark Chess into the game it is today. We strive to provide you with the best experience possible, and these updates are a testament to our dedication to your gaming satisfaction 🙌

Thank you for being part of the Dark Chess community. 
Don't forget to share your thoughts, suggestions, and join the discussion on our Steam community forums or in discord: https://discord.gg/5NGZ4DZ

Your feedback helps us make Dark Chess even better!

notes.title: 🎉 Mid-may update: Fixes, updates and Enhancements 🎉
notes.notes:
Dear Dark Chess Players,

We're excited to announce our latest update to Dark Chess, which arrived yesterday, May 16th, 2023. Our team has been diligently working to enhance your gaming experience and address your feedback, and we're eager to share the new features, fixes, and improvements included in this update.

Here's what you can look forward to in this update:

👥 Campaign Profiles: Play the campaign with multiple family members using up to 3 separate profiles, all while sharing the same achievements.
🌐 Server Update: Experience improved multiplayer gameplay with our enhanced game server, but remember to update your game before playing PvP.
🔐 Private Games with Friends: Enjoy a more convenient setup for private matches with friends, directly from the main menu.
🐜 Bug Fixes: We're continuing our efforts to identify and fix bugs, and we appreciate your help in reporting them.
🖱️ Match Start Clarification: We've added a message to avoid confusion around starting matches, ensuring a smoother experience.
🎨 Customization Menu Flow: Preview and confirm avatar and board item selections with an updated, more intuitive menu.
📜 Moves History: Gain more insights into previous moves with additional information and data in the notation.
🎨 Visual Updates: Experience richer visuals in the original game campaign with personalized flags, frames, and fogs for opponents.
🌐 Steam Rich Presence: Keep your friends updated with more detailed information on your opponents and game modes.
🔇 Additional Character Sound Bar: Mute voiceovers while keeping music and sound effects active.
🌍 Catalan Localization: One of our game supporters offered us to translate the game to Catalan. If all goes well we will be happy to provide our Catalan community to play the game in their native language.


We genuinely appreciate your support and feedback as we continue to improve Dark Chess. If you'd like to help us with translations or have any other suggestions, feel free to reach out to us via email at play@talltroll.com or join our Discord community.

Happy gaming, and thank you for being a part of the Dark Chess community!

Warm regards,

Tall Troll Games

notes.title: Il Vaticano Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Dark Chessians! 
We're excited to announce the latest update for the game, packed with new features and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience.


 With this build, we've fixed several bugs that were reported by our community, ensuring that the game runs smoothly and without issue. 
 Additionally, we've added the ability to choose which side to play for in solo mode, giving you more control over your strategy and allowing for more replayability.
 We've also added cloud saves on Steam, making it easier to access your saved games across multiple devices. 
 Hints for Campaign levels have been added as well, providing helpful tips and guidance to aid you on your chess adventure.
 Visually, Dark Chess has been updated to give the game a fresh new look, bringing an even more immersive chess experience to your screen. 
 We've also made balance fixes for Campaign opponents, as the Chess gods have been especially harsh on Juana and Vlad.


And finally, we have to address the elephant in the room - our team members were taken as hostages by Anarchy Chess, which led us to make an emergency visit to Il Vaticano. We'll leave it at that for now, but suffice it to say that we'll continue to do everything in our power to bring you the best possible Dark Chess experience.

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy these new updates to the game.

notes.title: One week after release of Dark Chess
notes.notes:
THIS IS NOT A GAME OF CLASSIC CHESS.
That should be our motto. 
The most significant criticism we receive is that our game is not a chess game, as indicated by negative reviews and game returns. It is disheartening to discover that people are not reading the description, not examining screenshots, nor attempting to comprehend why we chose to name the game Dark Chess. 

Disclaimer
We are considering adding a prominent disclaimer at the beginning of the game, ensuring that players understand that it is not a classic chess game. After they confirm they will be bounded to sell their souls if they ever say anything about it not being a classic chess game. 
We want to make it clear that the game is based on alternative rules and variations of chess, and we hope that players will appreciate and enjoy it for what it is. 

The Campaign
While we didn't originally plan for it, we have decided to create a single player Campaign for both Classic Chess and Dark Chess. Although some people may still find something to complain about (especially in regards to Classic Chess), we believe that it will be of interest to many of our players.

Feedback
We've received a lot of feedback from players since the game's release, and we're working hard to make improvements based on what you've told us. Here are a few things that were heavily requested:

[olist]
 The ability to change set pieces for the Campaign. We've heard you and are working on implementing this feature.
 Achievements. We understand that Steam achievements are important for many players, and even though the game already has its own achievements, we are working hard to implement Steam achievements as well.
 Windowed mode. We've received requests to enable windowed mode, and while it's already possible to access it using the alt+enter combination on your keyboard, we understand the convenience of having it available in the game settings. Therefore, we are currently working on adding the option to play in windowed mode in the game settings.
 Some players found the game too hard, so we've added an Easy and Normal Campaign modes to make it more accessible to chess newbies. 
 Puzzles are too hard. Puzzles were also a challenge for some players, so we've added a hint button for every Puzzle. The button first shows you the piece you need to move, followed by a 15-second cooldown before it shows you where to move it. You can repeat this process as many times as you need to.
 Bugs. We appreciate your help in finding bugs, and we're working to fix them as quickly as possible. If you encounter any issues, please let us know in discord or via email at play@talltroll.com.
 Some players have said that the game is too short, but it should take between 5 and 10 hours to complete the Campaign. You can also play Solo and PvP modes if you want to spend more time in the game.
[/olist]

If you don't like playing against a particular opponent in the Campaign, please let us know what you liked or disliked about the game. Your feedback will help us adjust and balance the game for the best possible experience.

You can help.
If you enjoyed playing the game, we would be grateful if you could leave a review on Steam. Your feedback helps other players and also helps Steam gain a better understanding of our game. Additionally, you can share the game with your friends and family. We have also added Steam's Remote Play Together, which allows you to play the game with your Steam friends, even if they do not own the game yet. 
Your support means a lot to us.
Thank you!

notes.title: Build update and release date announcement
notes.notes:
Attention all Dark Chess enthusiasts! 

We have updated the current build with a bunch of new stuff.

Campaign Difficulty: We heard your request to make the Campaign easier or harder.
The new Campaign Difficulty Levels feature allows players to adjust the challenge level of the game to their liking. Players can choose from a range of difficulty levels, from Easy to Hard, each with their own set of challenges and obstacles.

Collectibles: With the new Collectibles feature, you will be able to gather unique cards throughout the game. Shiny things for everyone!

Achievements: The new Achievement system adds a whole new level of challenge and satisfaction to the game. Players will be able to unlock achievements by completing specific objectives or reaching certain milestones. These can range from simple tasks like winning a game on any difficulty level to more challenging feats like beating the Campaign in one run! 

Customization: With the Customization feature, players will be able to personalize their game experience in a variety of ways. This can include changing the appearance of the game board and pieces, avatars, choosing custom backgrounds or flags. Something to make your appearance unique and beautiful.

All of these features have been carefully designed and implemented to enhance the overall gameplay experience, providing players with more ways to engage with the game and customize their experience. We hope that these updates will make the game even more enjoyable and satisfying for players of all skill levels. Please play the game, let us know of the bugs you encounter, leave the feedback on new features and share with us any ideas you have about improving the game.
This week we are working on fixing the bugs and online play.


Also we have another small announcement to make!

We are thrilled to announce that Dark Chess is going to be fully released next week!
It will be available to play on February 28th, 2023. 
So gather your friends, sharpen your wits, and get ready to experience the thrill of the game. 
Mark your calendars for February 28th and get ready to enter the world of Dark Chess!

notes.title: Early February Update
notes.notes:
Greetings friends!

Full release is coming soon and we're listening closely to your feedback. We understand that the Campaign mode may be challenging, especially for new chess players. To address this, we're introducing three different Campaign difficulty levels in the next week or two. For casual players, we're offering easier campaigns and puzzles. For those who found it too easy, we're adding more difficult challenges, puzzles, and tricks. Our goal is to make sure everyone enjoys the game, regardless of their chess skills.

We're also working on adding customization options, collectibles, and achievements to give players a sense of accomplishment and reward as they progress. 
Stay tuned for more updates soon.

notes.title: End of the Year Update
notes.notes:
Hello.

Last week we said we're working on the game and we are. 
No rest until we keep our word and give you the update. 
Last day of the year and here we are:
Please welcome new user interface. Some of the parts are hidden and will be unveiled as we add more features to the game. 

Spanish localization is added to the game making it 8 languages in total: English, Russian, Ukrainian, 
Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese, French and now Spanish.
If you want the game to be translated to your language and have the skills to do it, feel free to write us at play@talltroll.com

We are really happy to get your feedback good or bad. So don't be shy and let us know what you think is missing or can be improved in the game. 

Happy New Year!

notes.title: Happy Holidays update
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone.

The Holidays season is getting closer but we are not done yet.
Two weeks ago we showed you the roadmap and we're working hard to bring you a new game update until the end of the year.

This update will include a revamped user interface, some AI improvements, as well as a new localization language, Spanish, to better serve the game's Spanish-speaking players.

So far Dark Chess can be enjoyed in 
English
Russian
Ukrainian 
Simplified Chinese
Traditional Chinese
Brazilian Portuguese
French 
And more yet to come.

Happy holidays!

[olist]

 Minor tweaks and bug fixes to play the game more smoothly.
 Added a few more languages to the game: 

 French
 Ukrainian
 Russian
 Brazilian Portuguese

If you want to offer your help in improving current localization or translating the game into your native language you can do so in Discord server.
